svg.title: Schematic of the RAPID-MOCHA-WBTS observing array at 26.5N
svg.desc: Cross-section of the Atlantic basin from Florida to West Africa showing the three measurement subsystems: the Florida Strait submarine cable, the Ekman wind-driven surface layer, and the Western and Eastern boundary mooring arrays of bottom-pressure recorders and current meters. The reconstructed meridional stream function is sketched in profile on the right.
